description: Canonical source-owner map for the whole-game hot-reload cutover. Exactly one owner per source. Owners: game (eligible ordinary game implementation, the only set that becomes replaceable in one game.dll), resident (stable host/loader/device/transport/logging/worker mechanism that must not unload), bootstrap (process entry and orchestration), module:<name> (existing subsystem ModuleV1 DLL), launcher, tool, test, vendor. This map does not change build ownership; build.py keeps using config/modules/modules.json until the reviewed cutover.
precedence: module catalog: config/modules/modules.json sources are always module:<name>
ordered rules below; the first matching include rule wins

rules.reason: process entry and orchestration; must stay resident
resident host ABI, loader, state store, and generation barrier
loader, module host, and focused game-DLL host mechanism
process-wide logging, crash handling, and diagnostics sinks
window, GL context, and device lifetime
audio device engine and decode worker lifetime
socket, ICE, per-session server loop, and authored-world rebuild worker
process-memory persistence worker and rehost state
matchmaking poll thread and session state
self-test translation units compiled into the EXE; explicit test exception, not game.dll
ordinary game implementation default; replaceable in one game.dll
Recast/Detour navigation implementation compiled into the game build
unused or binary-only vendored C++ source; not in the canonical game build

overrides.reason: CLI/self-test launch surface owned by process bootstrap, not game.dll

resident_c.reason: GL entry-point dispatch must stay loaded with the context
ICE/UDP transport implementation; callback threads must outlive game generations

archives.reason: prebuilt archive linked into the EXE; source provenance unresolved, so it is not treated as a reloadable source set
